title: Health Resort west wing room 306 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 306 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 306 key (W306 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 306.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest Health Care Privacy - Part 2

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In the yard of the locked villa, on a stretcher next to the ambulance.

- In the back of the ambulance that is parked in front of the health resort.

sections.heading: Factory
sections.text: - In a locker on the second floor of the office area.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 306 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Blue keycard spawn location
- Loose loot (Currency, Meds)
- One weapon Spawn (M4A1)
- Two dead Scavs
